GameSave.title: GameSave
GameSave.description: Cloud save state for Mokay World stored per authenticated user.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase user UID owning this save.

currentRegionId.description: Active region identifier in Mokay World.

playerX.description: Current X coordinate of Boxy inside the region.

playerY.description: Current Y coordinate of Boxy inside the region.

mana.description: Current magic reserve for summoning Foskay.

chispas.description: Mokaya Spark currency earned from quests, pickups, and combat.

inventory.description: Map of item IDs to integer quantities.

quickSlots.description: Up to 3 quick-access consumable item IDs.

collectedBookIds.description: IDs of ancient books collected in the Grimoire.

discoveredKeywords.description: Unlocked gate keywords learned from collected books.

discoveredRegions.description: Visited or revealed region IDs on the world map.

discoveredLandmarkIds.description: IDs of landmarks discovered by Boxy and Foskay across Mokaya.

visitedVillages.description: Names of villages and neighborhoods visited across the 11 regions.

activeQuestIds.description: Accepted and currently active quest IDs.

trackedQuestId.description: Currently pinned quest ID on the HUD.

collectedForces.description: Ancestral forces gathered (creatividad, valentia, curiosidad, amistad).

collectedPickupIds.description: IDs of world pickups already collected.

npcRelationships.description: Map of NPC IDs to integer relationship affinity scores (-100 to 100).

unlockedAchievementIds.description: IDs of progression achievements unlocked by the player.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when save was first created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest cloud sync (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/saves/{saveId}.description: Per-user cloud save slot for Mokay World.
